expectations.text: Uses the live qubrics CLI path for durable agent inbox registration and owner-approved sending.
expectations.evidence: Actual response names @qubrics/cli, qubrics agent:register and qubrics agent:invite-owner as explanations only; sending requires owner approval and a scoped one-hour token, matching the frozen guide.

expectations.text: Identifies the source MCP distribution as qubrics-mcp and uses only qubrics-mcp executable names for it.
expectations.evidence: Actual response identifies qubrics-mcp as source distribution/server identity and delegates surface-specific configuration to the corrected MCP setup guide, with no old executable instruction.

expectations.text: Distinguishes source migration from publication and does not claim the renamed Python distribution is live.
expectations.evidence: Actual response: 'Do not assume the renamed Python distribution is published' and requires an installed source build or verified intended release before pipx install.

expectations.text: Does not request secrets, extract a CLI profile credential, register an inbox or perform a send.
expectations.evidence: Actual response does not request or extract credentials and explicitly claims no registration, authentication, mailbox read or send. It says reuse existing authorised profile.
